rootCauses: Zalo activates before macOS finishes launching it, then unhides itself during startup.
The visible-window early return could leave a notice behind another app.
Hidden-state filtering before merging a pending request could drop foreground intent.
changes: Wait for launch readiness and retain foreground intent.
Capture foreground intent before asynchronous handling.
Merge notice intent during an in-flight quiet hide.
Keep one floating, non-animated notice above ordinary startup windows.
Raise an existing notice without reactivating Habit Gate.
limitations: Zalo can still perform its own startup and Dock animations; this guard hides foreground windows rather than preventing process execution.
Window identity and bounds were observed at workspace event boundaries, not every rendered frame.
No new performance profile; existing polling interval unchanged.
privacy: Raw diagnostic logs and per-user state are kept outside the public repository.
